We need to read the problem carefully: Given array nums of length n, 1-indexed. An element nums[i] (1-indexed index i) is called non-special if i does NOT divide n (n % i != 0). Return sum of squares of all non-special elements.

Thus we simply iterate i from 1 to n inclusive, check if n % i != 0, then add nums[i-1]**2.

Check examples:

Example 1: nums = [1,2,3,4]; n = 4.

Check i=1: 4%1==0 => special => skip
i=2: 4%2==0 => special => skip
i=3: 4%3=1 !=0 => non-special => nums[2]=3 => square=9
i=4: 4%4==0 => special => skip

Sum = 9.
